diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma
legend: A case with brain and cerebrospinal fluid involvement showing neoplastic lymphocytes with occasional prominent nucleoli in the cerebrospinal fluid (Giemsa).

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma
legend: In this case, the lymphomatous population is somewhat pleomorphic morphologically, with occasional larger cells.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma
legend: This case has a high-grade appearance, with frequent apoptotic bodies and macrophages, imparting a starry-sky pattern.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma
legend: Neoplastic lymphocytes are medium-sized, showing regular, round to slightly irregular nuclei with slightly open chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. There are few admixed inflammatory cells.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma
legend: The epitheliotropic lymphoma cells in the peripheral zone are cytologically atypical, featuring medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours, moderate nuclear pleomorphism, more open chromatin, and distinct nucleoli.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma
legend: The lymphoma shows transmural infiltration of the small bowel wall, with ulceration but no necrosis.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma
legend: The mucosa adjacent to the tumour shows expanded and distorted intestinal villi containing epitheliotropic lymphoma cells.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma involving small intestine: growth patterns
legend: A The central portion of the tumour shows dense transmural infiltration by lymphoma, with no overt necrosis. The mucosa shows loss or reduction of villi.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma involving small intestine: growth patterns
legend: B Extensive horizontal mucosal spread of lymphoma is present in the peripheral zone.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma involving small intestine: characteristic epitheliotropism
legend: A The villi show prominent intraepithelial lymphocytosis in the mucosa distant from the tumour. Unlike in coeliac disease, villi are not atrophic, crypt hyperplasia is not seen, and there is no increase in plasma cells

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma involving small intestine: characteristic epitheliotropism
legend: B Intraepithelial lymphocytes have a bland cytological appearance, with round nuclei, condensed chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma involving small intestine: characteristic epitheliotropism
legend: C The intraepithelial lymphocytes show positive immunostaining for CD3, which highlights the marked epitheliotropism.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma: cytological spectrum
legend: A Most frequently encountered are small to medium-sized neoplastic cells with round or slightly irregular nuclei and dense chromatin

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma: cytological spectrum
legend: B Less frequently, the tumour shows a high-grade appearance, with frequent apoptotic bodies and macrophages, imparting a starry-sky pattern.

diagnosis: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma involving the small intestine
legend: There is a dense monomorphic infiltrate of lymphoma cells in the mucosa. There is marked epitheliotropism, with many neoplastic cells infiltrating the surface epithelium (web only).

legend: Cytological spectrum. An example with a predominance of medium-sized cells with round or slightly irregular nuclei and lightly eosinophilic cytoplasm.
